📜

Feature complete

To cover most scenarios, OpenIddict offers a server stack, a client stack and a validation stack that you can use independently... or together.

🌐

Usable in most .NET applications

The server and validation stacks can be used in any ASP.NET Core 2.1+ or ASP.NET 4.6.1+ application while the client stack can also be used in Windows, macOS or Linux desktop applications (and even Android or iOS apps!)

🆓

Released under a permissive license

OpenIddict is released under the Apache 2.0 license, which means it's open source and free to use, even in commercial projects.
